visualCharacteristics: Image left (3:2), text right: heading, paragraph, 2 chevron text links
contentPattern: One row, two cells: cell 1 = Scene7 picture (3:2 crop), cell 2 = h2 heading, paragraph, one plain link per paragraph (rendered as text link with chevron icon); bold/italic links render as buttons. Desktop 7/12 image + 5/12 text, vertically centred; stacked (image first) below 1024px. Image may be authored in the second cell to place it on the right.
